full_judgment: 6. The learned Assistant Judge, on consideration of the facts and circumstances of the case and materials on record, allowed the prayer for injunction by the impugned judgment and order dated 17-5-2003. In recording the order, the learned Assistant Judge took the view that on the basis of the mutated Khatian Nos. 1850, 1849 and 1848, the defendant has title and interest in the suit land and that if the defendant is not restrained from transferring the schedule land to anybody, there will be obstruction in the matter of realisation of dower and maintenance.
